title: Conductors, Insulators and Safety
summary: Which materials let current through? Why wires are copper with a plastic coat, and how to stay safe with electricity.

ib.note: Resistance and resistivity follow in MYP 5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Electricity: Circuits and their Components

objectives: I can test and classify materials as conductors or insulators.
I can explain why wires and appliances use both conductors and insulators.
I can describe how to use electricity safely.
misconceptions: It is safe to touch switches with wet hands because the switch is plastic.
